documents.title: Service policy
documents.text: Prep and local delivery are for Las Vegas residents only. We ship dry lyophilized vials only — not reconstituted product. Educational information only. The team calls to confirm, consult, and complete required documentation before payment.

documents.title: Locked information sheets
documents.text: Each live SKU has a locked information sheet as a Telegram file. Tap Sheet. Mix, starting amounts, and syringe marks live on that PDF — not in chat. Shop pages in Links are not the sheets.

documents.title: Payment
documents.text: Local Las Vegas: Zelle is best. The team shares Zelle details on the confirmation call. Prefer debit card? Tap Team, then Debit. Telegram interest orders are for Las Vegas residents only.

documents.title: Sales and discounts
documents.text: The floor team never invents a sale. A promotion appears only after TrueHold staff approve it case by case. If no approved promo is on file, there is no sale.

documents.title: No dosing in chat
documents.text: This host does not provide dosing, reconstitution, injection, or medical advice in chat. Tap Sheet for the locked PDF, or Team to talk with a person. Respect the tools.

documents.title: Why we are here
documents.text: We care that people get healthy, and we walk with them. “The first wealth is health.” — Ralph Waldo Emerson, The Conduct of Life, “Power” (1860). High-quality food and rest make a high-quality human. Peptides can help you aim at your best health. Educational only. If this house helped, you're welcome to tell others.

documents.title: Nature, science, and memory
documents.text: These signals showed up in bone broths, herbs, and fermentation long before lab glass. “Every realm of nature is marvellous.” — Aristotle, Parts of Animals I.5, trans. William Ogle (1882). The popular “let food be thy medicine” line is a later Hippocratic misquotation; the corpus itself says food can be excellent or poor medication depending on the case (On Nutriment 19, trans. W. H. S. Jones). Mix math stays on the locked sheet, not in chat.

documents.title: Respect, with care
documents.text: Too much of anything — even oxygen — can seriously hurt you. “All things are poison, and nothing is without poison; the dose alone makes it so a thing is not a poison.” — Paracelsus, Septem Defensiones, Third Defense (1538). We will not dose in chat. Learn with us — the door stays open.

documents.title: Vitamin C and oranges
documents.text: James Lind, a naval surgeon, compared scurvy treatments at sea and wrote: “The result of all my experiments was that oranges and lemons were the most effectual remedies for this distemper at sea.” — James Lind, A Treatise of the Scurvy (1753). Science later named the citrus factor vitamin C (Albert Szent-Györgyi, Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, 1937). Kitchen tools belong in open, kind hands.

documents.title: What you put in
documents.text: “Tell me what you eat, and I will tell you what you are.” — Jean Anthelme Brillat-Savarin, Physiologie du goût, Aphorism IV (1825). High-quality food and rest equal a high-quality human. Peptides are one of the tools that can help. Educational information. Las Vegas, dry vials, team consult for orders.
